gold.question: Under Directive (EU) 2019/770, who must prove that the digital content or digital service was supplied as Article 5 requires?
gold.reference_answer: The burden of proof is on the trader.
key_facts: 1. The burden of proof with regard to whether the digital content or digital service was supplied in accordance with Article 5 shall be on the trader.
